The 48 were then chosen from the 200 after a review of the draft, not at random. Anything measured on this file is exploratory and does not feed the register experiment or any analysis membership
naming: agscen_ only, never pairs_. Under a pairs_<STAMP> name with a stamp at or after tierb.start_utc, scripts/tierb_split.py would treat the file as a Tier B batch: is_holdout assigns 20 of the 200 draft clinical prompts (top_prompt) to the holdout, and sealed_pair would seal those rows. Four of the 20 are in this file: ss-nt-023, ss-nt-043, ss-nt-101, ss-nt-153. Under this agscen_ stem is_tierb_batch is false and sealed_pair returns false for all 96 prompts, with the stem or with no batch. Do not copy these pairs into a pairs_ batch. The draft's REPORT.md, SPEC.md and ledger.json say 21; recomputed on candidates.json at d9e66e8e the count is 20

Its class-level clinical_review label, owner_read_equivalence_and_domain_review_pending, overstates the review of this file until the owner records a read
